name: Yuki Tanaka
goals: Build a Kafka-based real-time streaming pipeline for content engagement
Create a data quality monitoring system for the data lake
Migrate ETL pipelines from on-prem to cloud-native
communication_style: Highly technical, discusses partitioning, idempotency, exactly-once semantics; uses Kafka, dbt, Spark terminology
pain_points: Data lake lineage is unknown, nobody trusts the numbers
Kafka consumer lag spikes every morning, root cause unknown
Informatica licenses cost $400K/year, board wants cloud migration
sample_prompts: Build a Kafka-based real-time pipeline with exactly-once semantics ingesting clickstream events and a consumer lag monitoring dashboard
Create a data quality framework using Great Expectations over our S3 data lake with automated anomaly alerts and data lineage
Build a dbt-based incremental transformation layer replacing our Informatica pipelines with full test coverage and documentation
